$description: Fixture design systems a docs screenshot recipe can load with system=<name> (scripts/build-docs-shots.ts). The pipeline installs the file as the active design system, under the label, before the recipe's route loads. `omit` drops token groups by dotted path before the install. Public material only: an invented brand or the blank starter, never a brand pack's own tokens (tests/docs-shot-systems.test.ts checks).

new-design-system.label: New design system
new-design-system.about: A design system with nothing chosen: the blank starter's neutrals and faces, and no logos. For the rooms as they first open.

wefthouse.label: Wefthouse
wefthouse.about: An invented textile brand with four colour roles in its own words and three colourways. For colour roles on a system that declares them.
